name: photo-to-threejs-building
description: Rebuild a building from one photograph as a procedural, measured Three.js model. Agent Skill (the method: measure, solve the camera, build, score against the photograph's own pixels) + MCP server (the deterministic instruments: view_crop, trace_edge, solve_camera, measure_pitch, compare_images, score_render, an auto-scoring workspace scaffold, and an inline viewer panel). The skill governs; the tools execute.
